Percentage* of Adult Day Services Centers
In 2022, 46% of U.S. adult day services centers used any telehealth tools.
compared with approximately one third of centers in the Midwest and South.
Source: National Center for Health Statistics, National Post-Acute and Long-Term Care Study, 2022.

methods_quotes.q: With 95% CIs indicated by error bars.
Adult day services centers with missing data or with directors who responded “don’t know” were excluded.
